framework_reasoning: MEDDPICC was chosen over BANT because this is an enterprise, multi-site mining deal: a Head of Operations is rarely the economic buyer, procurement and safety approval (Paper Process) at a listed miner is long, and the email already hints at a champion and a budget event (Q3). MEDDPICC separates those threads; BANT would collapse them into 'budget yes/no' and hide what the AE still has to discover.
